svg.title: Spinodal decomposition 2D | random geometry
svg.desc: Known input/setup schematic only; three samples. No predicted or evolved solution fields.

g.text: Varying: Positions and radii of two impermeable circular holes
Fixed: Outer ellipse, the same ten-mode initial field and materials; model time 0-3
Positive part of the fixed initial fluctuation
BC: Neutral wetting and zero flux on outer/hole walls; no interactions through holes.
Physics: Cahn-Hilliard phase separation/coarsening -> phi; mu follows its constitutive law.
Condition: Boundary + domain/initial-field points -> point tokens -> queries in each domain.
Setup only. Exactly the same ambient initial texture is restricted to each geometry.
